hints: Start by reproducing it with the browser's DevTools open. Watch the Network tab while you click Next: does the app ask the API for the new ticket at all? Compare what the URL says with what was requested.

The URL changes, but the details page is the same React component before and after the click: React Router keeps it mounted and only the route parameter changes. Look at how and when the details screen loads its ticket.

Open client/src/pages/TicketDetails.tsx and look at the useEffect that calls fetchTicket. Think about its dependency array: which values does the effect read, and which of them does React watch? Also think about what happens when an older request finishes after a newer one.
